scholarships.title: Allama Muhammad Iqbal Scholarship for Central Asia & Friendly Countries (Higher Education Commission, Pakistan)
scholarships.official_source: Higher Education Commission (HEC), Government of Pakistan

existing.funding_period: per month (monthly stipend component; the rate is not published)
existing.description: The Allama Muhammad Iqbal Scholarship is a Government of Pakistan initiative, administered by the Higher Education Commission, that brings students from Central Asian and other friendly countries to study in Pakistan. Over a five-year period it will award 350 scholarships across undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes at top-ranked Pakistani universities. HEC describes the award as fully funded, covering tuition fees in full plus a monthly stipend, an accommodation allowance and airfare as per policy. Applicants apply online through the HEC scholarship portal, and several eligible Asian countries are named in the programme's eligibility list.
eligibility: National of an eligible country: Central Asian countries (Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, Turkmenistan) or another listed friendly country (Jordan, Maldives, Uganda, Sudan, Congo, Angola, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Turkiye, Yemen, Syria, Iran, Malaysia, Zimbabwe, Russian Federation)
For the Engineering programme: GCE A' Levels or equivalent examination (Pre-Engineering) with at least 65% marks
For the Bachelor's degree programme: GCE A' Levels or equivalent examination in the required subjects with at least 60% marks
Must be able to provide an Equivalence Certificate from IBCC Pakistan once awarded the scholarship
Must pass any required tests or interviews, where applicable
benefits: Placement at a top-ranked university in Pakistan
requirements: Apply online through the official HEC scholarship portal
Sit any required tests or interviews
Obtain an Equivalence Certificate from IBCC Pakistan after being awarded the scholarship
application_method: Apply online through the official HEC scholarship portal
Appear in the required tests or interviews, if applicable
existing.selection_notes: HEC states that selected candidates will study at top-ranked universities in Pakistan, with the aim of fostering academic collaboration, knowledge exchange and mutual understanding between participating countries as part of Pakistan's broader internationalisation strategy.
existing.notes: HEC lists the programme's related components as an Allama Muhammad Iqbal Semester Exchange Program, the Pakistan Higher Education Expo in Central Asia, and leadership training for civil servants from Central Asian and other friendly countries.
existing.duration: Not published on the pages read; 350 places are spread over a five-year programme period.
existing.application_period: Multi-year programme with 350 places over five years; HEC publishes an online application through its scholarship portal but no application deadline on the pages read
existing.deadline_display: No deadline published; HEC runs the scheme as a multi-year programme
